parameters.content:
Import only. Do not activate until Postgres credentials exist.

The browser still does the arithmetic. This workflow checks the closed fields and inserts one row into bev_sessions. It must not reprice the car, write a sentence, or call a language model.

POST the JSON already built in session.ts to /webhook/bev-session.
Connect the Postgres credential named on the last node, then run one test. Leave it inactive until that test inserts a single row.

parameters.query: insert into bev_sessions (id, client_session, stage, payload) values ($1, $2, $3, $4) returning id
